programs.title: The Adventures of Tintin
programs.desc: Tintin's new model ship sparks an adventure of intrigue and theft. He uncovers a historical mystery involving treasure, rival groups and a quest for scrolls revealing a sunken ship's location.

programs.title: Exorcist: The Beginning
programs.desc: Priest Merrin struggles with his faith due to his troubled past. He joins an excavation project to investigate an ancient church, but things change when something sinister awakens.

programs.title: The Man From Toronto
programs.desc: A struggling entrepreneur plans a surprise for his wife's birthday, but due to a twist of fate, he gets caught in the middle of an operation to apprehend an assassin.

programs.title: Charlie's Angels: Full Throttle
programs.desc: The Angels track down rings containing the names of those in the FBI's witness protection programme. However, the witnesses begin to get murdered one by one.

programs.title: A-X-L
programs.desc: Miles befriends A-X-L, a robotic dog, when he manages to activate its owner-pairing technology. However, Miles's life takes an unusual turn when A-X-L's creators come searching for it.

programs.title: Resident Evil
programs.desc: Two associates of an elite commando team fight an army of zombies controlled by an evil desktop computer in a genetic research facility.

programs.title: Monster Hunter
programs.desc: Captain Artemis and her group of soldiers are pulled into a world where dangerous monsters and humans co-exist. Grappled by danger, they must find a way to escape with help from a mysterious hunter.

programs.title: Bloodshot
programs.desc: A soldier who died on duty is resurrected and given superhuman abilities by the RST Corp. But soon he realises the truth about his past and his resurrection and sets out to get revenge.

programs.title: After Earth
programs.desc: A father-son duo crash-land on Earth, a millennium after an accident forced humans to evacuate the planet. With the father grievously injured, the son must put his life on the line to secure help.

programs.title: Spider-Man 3
programs.desc: A symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, intensifying his abilities and aggression. Now, he must face the challenges that his new powers bring while simultaneously fighting new villains.

programs.title: The Water Horse
programs.desc: Young Angus Mac Morrow discovers a mysterious egg that grows up to be the Loch Ness monster. As they form a strong relationship, the boy's family refuses to believe in the creature's existence.

programs.title: Men in Black: International
programs.desc: Agent M, a probationary member of the MIB, teams up with Agent H and uncovers a sinister plot that reveals a traitor in the organisation aiding an alien invasion.

programs.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programs.desc: After a night of revelry, four friends accidentally run over a man and dump his body to conceal their secret, unaware that the following year brings a series of eerie events in their lives.

programs.title: Godzilla
programs.desc: The fallout of a military nuclear test causes an iguana to mutate into a giant monster. Now this monster lays waste to cannery ships and New York City in order to feed and protect its brood.

programs.title: Insidious: Chapter 2
programs.desc: Josh Lambert and his family relocate to his mother's old house in the hopes of recovering from past trauma. However, they soon encounter strange and chilling paranormal events.

programs.title: 2 Guns
programs.desc: Two undercover agents, Robert and Michael, aim to expose Manny 'Papi' Greco, a drug lord. Unaware of each other's true identities, the two get into trouble when they finally meet Papi.
